srv.consent.needGoPlan: waiting for "GO plan" (the spec is not approved)
srv.consent.noRunDir: no run directory ({dir}) for the consent entry
srv.consent.realization: waiting for the end of implementation ({tip})
srv.consent.specLoop: waiting for the end of the spec loop (the session will report "waiting: GO plan")
srv.delivery.cpTipIgnored: CP → {where} (Handover: value ignored, it is not a branch name); {tip}

srv.expert.action: Answer the expert questions on the questions page; the session is waiting for the answer.
srv.feedback.card: A card session does not record a consent to send: the user types the word in the session that sends. If this is not a card session, remove the file .skillsync/card-alias in the project directory of the server of this page (or restart the server without SKILLSYNC_CARD_ALIAS).
srv.feedback.contentChanged: The draft or its target changed after the preview. Refresh the page and review the preview again.
srv.feedback.failed: The consent to send could not be recorded. Refresh the page and try again.
srv.feedback.noPreview: This draft has no preview to approve. Prepare the preview and refresh the page.
srv.feedback.scan: The preview did not pass the leak scan. Prepare the preview again.
srv.feedback.sent: This draft with this content was already sent, or its consent was used.
srv.feedback.stale: The preview is out of date (too old, or its target is no longer trusted). Prepare the preview again.
srv.http.approvalsOff: Approvals from this page are disabled (--no-approvals).
srv.http.docUnavailable: The document is unavailable (it is not on the allowed list or does not exist).
srv.http.fileChanged: The file has changed since it was displayed; read it again and approve once more.
srv.http.headChanged: HEAD has changed since the page was displayed; refresh the page and check the changes.
srv.http.hostApprove: The consent socket answers only under localhost, the IP address of this machine or a host from --approve-host (Host header: {shown}).
srv.http.hostBoth: The page answers only under localhost or a host from --approve-host (read and consents) or --read-host (read only) (Host header: {shown}).
srv.http.hostRead: The read socket answers only under localhost, the IP address of this machine, its own name or a host from --read-host (Host header: {shown}).
srv.http.hostRefused: The page answers only under localhost or a host from --approve-host (Host header).
srv.http.nextHint: The consent is saved in the file. A session waiting for it resumes by itself (change watch and a 30-minute alarm); if it does not resume within a minute, type "continue" in the session.
srv.http.noTestRun: There is no such test run.
srv.http.notPossible: "{word}" is not possible right now; refresh the page.
srv.http.notPossibleFor: "{word}" is not possible right now for {rel}; refresh the page.
srv.http.planStateChanged: The plan status has changed since the page was displayed; refresh the page and check the plan.
srv.http.proxyRefused: A write through an intermediary (Forwarded, X-Forwarded-*, X-Real-IP) is refused; start the server with --allow-proxy-headers if it is a trusted reverse proxy.
srv.http.saveFailed: The consent could not be saved ({reason}); type the word in the session.
srv.http.serverError: Status server error; details are in the console.
srv.http.tokenRefused: The consent token is missing or wrong: open the address from the server console or from `skillsync dashboard url`.
srv.link.noPrototype: The spec points to prototype {proto}, which is not in {dir}/.
srv.link.noRun: The spec does not name a run (no "Run:" line), so the page cannot see checkpoints or reports.
srv.link.noRunDir: Run directory {id} does not exist in {dir}/, so the page cannot see checkpoints or reports.
srv.status.noPre: no pre-implement: the spec has sections {sections}, and .skillsync/runs/{run}/ has no pre-implement*.md with a "Verdict: READY|NEEDS_CHANGES|BLOCKED" line
srv.status.noPreNoRun: no pre-implement: the spec has sections {sections}, and the plan has no valid "Run:" line (it is not known where to look for the report)
srv.status.preVerdict: pre-implement: verdict {verdict} ({report}); resolve the findings before "GO implement"
srv.tip.codeReviews: code-review*/final-review* reports in the run directory
srv.tip.planReviews: plan review rounds in the run directory
srv.tip.preImplement: readiness gate before a risky change
srv.tip.specReviews: spec review rounds in the run directory
srv.wait.cp: Check the result and approve "CP" with the button in Act III or type it in the session.
srv.wait.generic: The session is waiting: {what}. Reply in the session.
srv.wait.goImplement: Read the plan and approve "GO implement" with the button or type it in the session (for a direct plan "GO" is enough).
srv.wait.goPlan: Read the spec and approve "GO plan" with the button or type it in the session.
srv.wait.prototype: Open the prototype, review the screens and accept them (or leave comments).
srv.wait.questions: Answer the questions in the session ({what}).
srv.wait.ready: Check the draft PR and approve "READY" with the button in Act III or type it in the session.
srv.wait.retro: Decide the retrospective proposal: type "TAK ..." or "NIE ..." ({what}).
srv.writing.action: The agent is writing the prototype screens; acceptance returns when it finishes. You do not need to do anything.
srv.writing.whatCount: agent is writing screens ({done} of {planned}, until {until})

ui.forecast.tipRange: A forecast, not a measurement: the first and third quartile of the work per step (from the gaps between finished steps, without waiting) × the steps left; the end time = the moment the page was refreshed + this range. It ignores the size of the steps and waiting for people. Approximate: a replay on real runs showed that this is an order of magnitude, not a promise.
ui.forecast.tipTempo: A forecast, not a measurement: the median work per step from the gaps between finished steps, without waiting. This view gives neither a sum nor an end time. It ignores the size of the steps and waiting for people; approximate, not a promise.

ui.glossary.actText: One of the three big steps of a run: spec, plan, implementation.
ui.glossary.consentText: A human decision: GO plan, GO implement, CP (commit and push), READY (a draft PR ready for review).
ui.glossary.debtText: A matter consciously postponed, written in the plan or in the retrospective.
ui.glossary.etaText: The estimated end of the current operation given by the agent in a progress report.
ui.glossary.phaseText: A group of steps in the plan; done when all its steps are done.
ui.glossary.resultText: The Result section of the plan: what was actually done, with the checks and the deviations.
ui.glossary.stageText: A tile in an act; a pulsing dot marks the stage that is going on now.
ui.glossary.stepText: One item of the Progress list in the plan with an identifier, e.g. F1.2.
ui.glossary.title: Concepts
ui.glossary.verifyText: Steps reported as done but not yet ticked in the plan; the lighter shade of the bar.

ui.liveTip.live: Changes in the plan, spec and checkpoints appear at once (SSE).
ui.liveTip.polling: The live channel is unavailable - the page asks the server every 5 s and returns to live mode by itself.
